questions.text_english: Who among the following published 'Samvad Kaumudi'?
questions.solution: Option C is correct because 'Samvad Kaumudi' was a Bengali weekly newspaper published from Kolkata in the first half of the 19th century by the prominent social reformer Raja Rammohan Roy. The other options are incorrect as they were associated with different publications or movements.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है क्योंकि 'संवाद कौमुदी' 19वीं सदी के पूर्वार्ध में प्रमुख समाज सुधारक राजा राममोहन राय द्वारा कोलकाता से प्रकाशित एक बंगाली साप्ताहिक समाचार पत्र था।

questions.text:
स्तंभ-I का मिलान स्तंभ-II से कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
स्तंभ - I (धातु) : I. लौह, II. अलौह, III. अधात्विक, IV. ऊर्जा
स्तंभ - II (उदाहरण) : a. कोयला, b. ग्रेनाइट, c. बॉक्साइट, d. कोबाल्ट
questions.text_english:
Match Column-I with Column-II and choose the correct option.
Column-I (Minerals) : I. Ferrous, II. Non-Ferrous, III. Non-Metallic, IV. Energy
Column-II (Examples) : a. Coal, b. Granite, c. Bauxite, d. Cobalt
questions.solution: Option B is correct. Cobalt is a ferrous mineral (I-d), Bauxite is a non-ferrous mineral (II-c), Granite is a non-metallic mineral (III-b), and Coal is an energy mineral (IV-a). This matching completely aligns with Option B.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प B सही है। कोबाल्ट एक लौह खनिज है (I-d), बॉक्साइट एक अलौह खनिज है (II-c), ग्रेनाइट एक अधात्विक खनिज है (III-b), और कोयला एक ऊर्जा खनिज है (IV-a)। यह मिलान पूरी तरह से विकल्प B के साथ संरेखित है।

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को पढ़िए और उत्तर के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
अभिकथन (A) : प्रशा की पहल पर एक शुल्क संघ 'जॉलवेराइन' स्थापित किया गया ।
कारण (R) : यह एकीकृत आर्थिक क्षेत्र के सृजन की बात थी जहाँ वस्तुओं, लोग और पूँजी का आवागमन बाधारहित हो ।
questions.text_english:
Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both statements and choose the correct option:
Assertion (A): On Prussian initiative 'Zolleverin' Custom Union was formed.
Reason (R) It was to create unified economic territory allowing the unhindered movement of goods, people and capital.

options.A: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options_english.A: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options_english.B: Both (A) and (R) are correct, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.solution: Option A is correct because the Zollverein was indeed a customs union formed in 1834 at the initiative of Prussia. The primary reason for its formation was to eliminate tariff barriers and create a unified economic territory to allow the free movement of goods, people, and capital across German states. Thus, the reason correctly explains the assertion.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प A सही है क्योंकि ज़ॉलवेराइन वास्तव में 1834 में प्रशा की पहल पर गठित एक सीमा शुल्क संघ था। इसके गठन का प्राथमिक कारण टैरिफ बाधाओं को समाप्त करना और जर्मन राज्यों में वस्तुओं, लोगों और पूंजी की मुक्त आवाजाही की अनुमति देने के लिए एक एकीकृत आर्थिक क्षेत्र बनाना था। इस प्रकार, कारण अभिकथन की सही व्याख्या करता है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित विकल्पों में से बेल्जियम में सत्ता साझेदारी व्यवस्था के प्राथमिक उद्देश्य की पहचान कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Identify the primary objective of power sharing arrangements in Belgium from the following options.

options.A: सरकार का एकात्मक रूप स्थापित करना ।
options.C: डच के सांस्कृतिक और शैक्षिक मामलों की स्थापना ।
options.D: भाषाई और क्षेत्रीय हितों को समायोजित करना ।

options_english.A: Establishing a unitary form of government.
options_english.C: Establishing cultural and educational matters of Dutch.

questions.solution: Option D is correct. The primary objective of power sharing in Belgium was to accommodate the diverse linguistic (Dutch, French, German) and regional interests within the country to prevent civil conflict and ensure political stability. The other options describe unitary or biased models which contradict Belgium's federal design.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प D सही है। बेल्जियम में सत्ता की साझेदारी का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य गृहयुद्ध को रोकने और राजनीतिक स्थिरता सुनिश्चित करने के लिए देश के भीतर विविध भाषाई (डच, फ्रेंच, जर्मन) और क्षेत्रीय हितों को समायोजित करना था।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक प्रमुख संकेतक है जिसका उपयोग किसी देश के विकास को मापने के लिए किया जाता है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is a key indicator used to measure a country's development?
questions.solution: Option C is correct. Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is a widely used key macroeconomic indicator to measure the overall economic output and development of a country over a specific period. It is more comprehensive than measuring just primary or secondary production.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है। सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (जीडीपी) एक प्रमुख व्यापक आर्थिक संकेतक है जिसका उपयोग किसी विशिष्ट अवधि में किसी देश के समग्र आर्थिक उत्पादन और विकास को मापने के लिए किया जाता है।

questions.text:
'पूर्वी भारत में उपजा बौद्ध धर्म कई दिशाओं में फैला ।'
इसके फैलाव के निम्नलिखित कारणों को पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
I. सांस्कृतिक आदान-प्रदान के कारण
II. सिल्क मार्ग के कारण
III. व्यापार और मुसाफिरों के कारण
IV. यूरोपवासियों के प्रयास के कारण
questions.text_english:
'Buddhism emerged from eastern India and spread in several directions.'
Read the following reasons for its spread and choose the correct option.
I. Due to Cultural exchange
II. Due to Silk route
III. Due to trade & travellers
IV. Due to European efforts

options.A: केवल I, II और IV सही हैं।
options.B: केवल II, III और IV सही हैं।
options.C: केवल I, II और III सही हैं।
options.D: केवल I, III और IV सही हैं।

options_english.A: Only I, II and IV are correct.
options_english.B: Only II, III and IV are correct.
options_english.C: Only I, II and III are correct.
options_english.D: Only I, III and IV are correct.

questions.solution: Option C is correct. Buddhism spread due to cultural exchanges, the existence of the Silk Route, and the movement of traders, monks, and travellers across Asia. European efforts (Statement IV) had nothing to do with the ancient spread of Buddhism.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है। बौद्ध धर्म सांस्कृतिक आदान-प्रदान, सिल्क रूट के अस्तित्व और पूरे एशिया में व्यापारियों, भिक्षुओं और यात्रियों की आवाजाही के कारण फैला। यूरोपीय प्रयासों (कथन IV) का बौद्ध धर्म के प्राचीन प्रसार से कोई लेना-देना नहीं था।

questions.text:
भारतीय राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन से संबंधित निम्नलिखित घटनाओं को कालक्रमानुसार व्यवस्थित कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
I. स्वराज पार्टी का गठन
II. भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का लाहौर अधिवेशन
III. गांधी-इर्विन समझौता
IV. दमित वर्ग एसोसिएशन की स्थापना
questions.text_english:
Arrange the following events of Indian National Movement in chronological order and choose the correct option.
I. Formation of Swaraj Party
II. Lahore Session of the Indian National Congress
III. Gandhi-Irwin Pact
IV. Formation of Depressed Class Association
questions.solution: Option B is correct. The correct chronological sequence is: Formation of Swaraj Party (1923), followed by the Lahore Session of the Indian National Congress (December 1929), then the Formation of Depressed Class Association by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar (1930), and finally the Gandhi-Irwin Pact (March 1931). Thus, the order is I, II, IV, III.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प B सही है। सही कालानुक्रमिक क्रम है: स्वराज पार्टी का गठन (1923), उसके बाद भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का लाहौर अधिवेशन (दिसंबर 1929), फिर डॉ. बी.आर. अंबेडकर द्वारा दमित वर्ग एसोसिएशन का गठन (1930), और अंत में गांधी-इर्विन समझौता (मार्च 1931)। इस प्रकार, क्रम I, II, IV, III है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी सिंचाई प्रणाली मेघालय में है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following is the irrigation system in Meghalaya ?

options.A: केवल बरसात के मौसम में भूमि की सिंचाई करना ।
options.B: सिंचाई के लिए बड़ी मात्रा में पानी का उपयोग करना ।
options.D: बाँस ड्रिप सिंचाई प्रणाली का उपयोग करना ।

options_english.A: To irrigate land only during rainy season.
options_english.B: To use large volumes of water for irrigation.
options_english.D: To use bamboo drip irrigation system.

questions.solution: Option D is correct. The bamboo drip irrigation system is a traditional 200-year-old method widely practiced in Meghalaya to transport stream and spring water using bamboo pipes to irrigate crops.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प D सही है। बाँस ड्रिप सिंचाई प्रणाली एक पारंपरिक 200 साल पुरानी विधि है जिसका मेघालय में व्यापक रूप से अभ्यास किया जाता है। इसमें फसलों की सिंचाई के लिए बाँस के पाइपों का उपयोग करके झरने के पानी को ले जाया जाता है।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित जानकारियों को पढ़िए और फसल की पहचान कीजिए ।
• यह भारत में अधिकांश लोगों की प्रमुख खाद्यान्न फसल है।
• भारत इस फसल का दूसरा सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक देश है।
• यह एक खरीफ़ फसल है।
• इसे अधिक आर्द्रता के साथ 100 सेमी वार्षिक वर्षा की आवश्यकता होती है।
questions.text_english:
Read the following informations and identify the crop.
• It is the staple food crop of majority of people in India.
• India is the second largest producer of this crop.
• It is a Kharif crop.
• It requires high humidity with 100 cm of annual rainfall.
questions.solution: Option D is correct. Rice is a major Kharif crop requiring high temperature, high humidity, and annual rainfall above 100 cm. India is the second-largest producer of rice in the world after China, and it is the staple food for a majority of Indians.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प D सही है। चावल एक प्रमुख खरीफ़ फसल है जिसके लिए उच्च तापमान, उच्च आर्द्रता और 100 सेमी से अधिक वार्षिक वर्षा की आवश्यकता होती है। भारत दुनिया में चावल का दूसरा सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक है और यह अधिकांश भारतीयों का मुख्य भोजन है।

questions.text:
स्तंभ-I का मिलान स्तंभ-II से कीजिए और निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
स्तंभ - I (भारतीय संविधान में विषयों की सूची) : I. संघ सूची, II. राज्य सूची, III. समवर्ती सूची, IV. बचे हुए विषयों की सूची
स्तंभ - II (विषय) : a. ट्रेड यूनियन, b. बैंकिंग, c. पुलिस, d. इंटरनेट
questions.text_english:
Match Column-I with Column-II and choose the correct option from the following:
Column-I (Subject List in the Indian Constitution) : I. Union List, II. State List, III. Concurrent List, IV. Residuary List
Column-II (Subject) : a. Trade Union, b. Banking, c. Police, d. Internet
questions.solution: Option B is correct. Banking falls under the Union List (I-b) because it requires a uniform national policy. Police is under the State List (II-c) as it is a matter of state administration. Trade Unions fall under the Concurrent List (III-a). Internet or Computer Software is a newer subject not mentioned in the original lists and falls under Residuary Powers (IV-d).
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प B सही है। बैंकिंग संघ सूची (I-b) के अंतर्गत आता है। पुलिस राज्य सूची (II-c) के अधीन है। ट्रेड यूनियन समवर्ती सूची (III-a) के अंतर्गत आते हैं। इंटरनेट या कंप्यूटर सॉफ्टवेयर एक नया विषय है जो अवशिष्ट शक्तियों (IV-d) के अंतर्गत आता है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों में से कौन-सा महिला सशक्तिकरण का सबसे उपयुक्त वर्णन है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following statements, best describes women empowerment?

options.A: पुरुषों को नेतृत्व की भूमिका बढ़ाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करना ।
options.B: पुरुषों पर महिलाओं की श्रेष्ठता को बढ़ावा देना ।
options.C: महिलाओं के लिए समान अवसर और अधिकार सुनिश्चित करना ।
options.D: सभी क्षेत्रों में पुरुषों के अधिकारों को सीमित करना ।

options_english.A: Encouraging men to take leadership roles.
options_english.B: Promoting superiority of women over men.
options_english.C: Ensuring equal opportunities and rights for women.
options_english.D: Limiting the rights of men in all spheres.

questions.solution: Option C is correct because women empowerment fundamentally focuses on providing equal rights, resources, and opportunities to women, allowing them equal footing with men without suppressing either gender. The other options involve inequality or restriction of rights.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है क्योंकि महिला सशक्तिकरण मौलिक रूप से महिलाओं को समान अधिकार, संसाधन और अवसर प्रदान करने पर केंद्रित है, जिससे उन्हें पुरुषों के साथ समान स्तर मिल सके।

questions.text: राजनीतिक दल जनता के प्रति जवाबदेही कैसे सुनिश्चित करते हैं ? निम्नलिखित में से सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: How do Political Parties ensure accountability to the public? Choose the most suitable option from the following.

options.B: सोशल मीडिया मुहिम के माध्यम से
options.D: चुनाव और मतदाताओं के समर्थन के माध्यम से

questions.solution: Option D is correct. In a democracy, the primary mechanism through which political parties ensure accountability to the public is through regular elections. They must seek the support and mandate of the voters to gain or retain power.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प D सही है। लोकतंत्र में, राजनीतिक दल मुख्य रूप से नियमित चुनावों के माध्यम से जनता के प्रति अपनी जवाबदेही सुनिश्चित करते हैं। सत्ता हासिल करने या बनाए रखने के लिए उन्हें मतदाताओं का समर्थन मांगना पड़ता है।
questions.topic: Meaning and Functions of Political Parties

questions.text:
लोकतंत्र के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
I. नागरिकों में समानता लाना
II. कुछ लोगों द्वारा सरकार बनाना
III. मानव अधिकार का संरक्षण करना
IV. नियंत्रण और संतुलन व्यवस्था बनाना
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements regarding democracy and choose the correct option.
I. Promotes equality among citizens
II. Government by few individuals
III. Protection of human rights
IV. Ensures checks and balance system
questions.solution: Option C is correct. Democracy is characterized by promoting equality (I), protecting human rights (III), and maintaining a system of checks and balances (IV). Statement II is incorrect because a 'government by few individuals' defines an oligarchy, not a democracy.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है। लोकतंत्र समानता को बढ़ावा देने (I), मानवाधिकारों की रक्षा (III), और नियंत्रण तथा संतुलन प्रणाली (IV) बनाए रखने की विशेषता है। कथन II गलत है क्योंकि 'कुछ व्यक्तियों द्वारा सरकार' एक कुलीनतंत्र है, लोकतंत्र नहीं।
questions.topic: How do we assess democracy's outcomes?

questions.text: केन्द्र और राज्यों के बीच विवादों को सुलझाने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन जिम्मेदार है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is responsible for resolving disputes between Centre and States?
questions.solution: Option B is correct. In a federal system like India, the independent judiciary, particularly the Supreme Court, acts as an umpire and has the original jurisdiction to resolve disputes arising between the Central Government and State Governments.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प B सही है। भारत जैसी संघीय व्यवस्था में, स्वतंत्र न्यायपालिका, विशेष रूप से सर्वोच्च न्यायालय, अंपायर के रूप में कार्य करती है और केंद्र तथा राज्यों के बीच विवादों को सुलझाने की शक्ति रखती है।

questions.text_english: Which one of the following is a significant aspect of globalisation ?
questions.solution: Option D is correct. Globalization fundamentally drives the integration of markets globally, allowing multinational corporations and domestic producers to access and compete in new markets across national boundaries.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प D सही है। वैश्वीकरण मौलिक रूप से विश्व स्तर पर बाजारों के एकीकरण को प्रेरित करता है, जिससे बहुराष्ट्रीय निगमों और उत्पादकों को राष्ट्रीय सीमाओं के पार नए बाजारों तक पहुंचने की अनुमति मिलती है।

questions.text_english: Primary, Secondary and Tertiary sectors are divided in which one of the following basis?
questions.solution: Option B is correct. Sectors of the economy are divided into primary, secondary, and tertiary based on the 'nature of activities' performed, such as extracting natural resources (primary), manufacturing (secondary), or providing services (tertiary).
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प B सही है। अर्थव्यवस्था के क्षेत्रों को की जाने वाली 'गतिविधियों की प्रकृति' के आधार पर प्राथमिक, द्वितीयक और तृतीयक में विभाजित किया जाता है, जैसे प्राकृतिक संसाधनों को निकालना (प्राथमिक), विनिर्माण (द्वितीयक), या सेवाएं प्रदान करना (तृतीयक)।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा बैंक देश में मुद्रा को जारी करता है और ऋण प्रणाली को नियंत्रित करता है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following banks in India controls the issuance of currency and regulates the credit system in the country?
questions.solution: Option C is correct. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is the central bank of the country. It issues currency notes on behalf of the Central Government and supervises the functioning of formal sources of loans and credit systems.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है। भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (RBI) देश का केंद्रीय बैंक है। यह केंद्र सरकार की ओर से मुद्रा नोट जारी करता है और ऋण और ऋण प्रणाली के औपचारिक स्रोतों के कामकाज की देखरेख करता है।

questions.text: सोलहवीं सदी के दौरान भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप व्यापारिक नेटवर्क के लिए किस प्रकार महत्त्वपूर्ण था ? स्पष्ट कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: How was the Indian subcontinent crucial for the trade network during the sixteenth century? Explain.

key_points: Central location in the Indian Ocean connecting East and West.
Rich source of traded goods like spices, textiles, and precious metals.

questions.solution: During the 16th century, the Indian subcontinent was crucial for the trade network because of its strategic geographical location, serving as a central hub in the Indian Ocean connecting Europe, Africa, and East Asia. Furthermore, it was deeply integrated into the global economy through the robust export of valuable commodities like cotton textiles, silk, and spices, which were highly sought after worldwide.
questions.solution_hindi: 16वीं शताब्दी के दौरान, भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप व्यापार नेटवर्क के लिए महत्वपूर्ण था क्योंकि इसकी रणनीतिक भौगोलिक स्थिति थी, जो हिंद महासागर में यूरोप, अफ्रीका और पूर्वी एशिया को जोड़ने वाले केंद्रीय केंद्र के रूप में कार्य करती थी। इसके अतिरिक्त, सूती वस्त्र, रेशम और मसालों जैसी मूल्यवान वस्तुओं के मजबूत निर्यात के माध्यम से यह वैश्विक अर्थव्यवस्था में गहराई से एकीकृत था।

questions.text_english: How does the United Nations Development Program's (UNDP's) developmental criterion differ from the World Bank? Explain.

key_points: World Bank uses purely economic indicator (Per capita income).
UNDP uses Human Development Index comprising health, education, and income.

questions.solution: The World Bank measures development solely based on per capita income to classify countries as rich or poor. In contrast, the UNDP uses the Human Development Index (HDI), a broader criterion that combines educational levels, health status (life expectancy), and per capita income to assess true development.

questions.text_english: Role of women is gradually enhancing in the politics of the country. Examine the statement.

key_points: Reservation of 33% seats in local government bodies.
Increased literacy and political awareness leading to higher voter turnout and representation.

questions.solution: The role of women in Indian politics is growing, primarily due to the reservation of one-third of seats in Panchayats and Municipalities, which brought over a million women into leadership roles. Furthermore, rising education levels and feminist movements have improved political awareness, leading to higher female voter turnouts and active participation in political discourse.
questions.solution_hindi: भारतीय राजनीति में महिलाओं की भूमिका बढ़ रही है, मुख्य रूप से पंचायतों और नगर पालिकाओं में एक तिहाई सीटों के आरक्षण के कारण, जिससे दस लाख से अधिक महिलाएं नेतृत्व की भूमिका में आ गईं। इसके अलावा, शिक्षा के बढ़ते स्तर ने राजनीतिक जागरूकता में सुधार किया है, जिससे महिला मतदाताओं की भागीदारी बढ़ी है।

sub_questions.text_english: Analyse the process of German Unification.

key_points: Prussia took the leadership of the movement under Otto von Bismarck.
Three wars over seven years with Austria, Denmark, and France ended in Prussian victory.
In January 1871, the Prussian king, William I, was proclaimed German Emperor.

sub_questions.solution: The process of German unification was spearheaded by Prussia under the chief minister Otto von Bismarck. Utilizing the Prussian army and bureaucracy, Bismarck orchestrated three wars over seven years against Austria, Denmark, and France. These conflicts ended in decisive Prussian victories, unifying the German states. Consequently, in January 1871, the Prussian King William I was proclaimed the German Emperor at Versailles, marking the birth of a unified Germany.

sub_questions.text: इटली के एकीकरण की प्रक्रिया का विश्लेषण कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Analyse the process of Italian Unification.

key_points: Giuseppe Mazzini formulated the initial programme and formed 'Young Italy'.
Chief Minister Cavour led the movement unifying regions via a tactful alliance with France.
Giuseppe Garibaldi led armed volunteers to drive out Spanish rulers from the South.

sub_questions.solution: Italian unification involved three key leaders. Initially, Giuseppe Mazzini inspired the youth by forming 'Young Italy'. Later, Chief Minister Cavour led the movement, using a diplomatic alliance with France to defeat Austrian forces in 1859. Concurrently, Giuseppe Garibaldi and his armed volunteers (Red Shirts) marched into South Italy and ousted the Spanish rulers. In 1861, Victor Emmanuel II was declared the king of unified Italy.

questions.text_english: The development process of India has experienced transformation due to the significant influence of Information Technology (I.T.) and Electronic Industry. Explain the statement with examples.

key_points: Creation of massive employment opportunities, especially for women.
Significant contributor to foreign exchange generation via BPOs.
Development of IT parks in cities like Bengaluru, transforming urban economies.

questions.solution: The Information Technology and Electronic Industry has drastically transformed India's economy by generating millions of jobs, with women comprising nearly one-third of this workforce. It has driven immense foreign exchange earnings through successful Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) services globally. For example, the establishment of IT parks in cities like Bengaluru and Hyderabad has turned them into thriving global tech hubs, modernizing infrastructure and boosting the service sector.
questions.solution_hindi: सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी और इलेक्ट्रॉनिक उद्योग ने लाखों नौकरियां पैदा करके भारत की अर्थव्यवस्था को काफी बदल दिया है, जिसमें लगभग एक तिहाई कार्यबल महिलाएं हैं। इसने वैश्विक स्तर पर सफल बिजनेस प्रोसेस आउटसोर्सिंग (बीपीओ) सेवाओं के माध्यम से भारी विदेशी मुद्रा आय को बढ़ाया है। उदाहरण के लिए, बेंगलुरु और हैदराबाद जैसे शहरों में आईटी पार्कों की स्थापना ने उन्हें वैश्विक तकनीकी हब में बदल दिया है।

questions.text_english: Describe any three functions of the Political Parties.

key_points: Contesting elections by putting up candidates.
Forming and running the government if they win the majority.
Playing the role of the opposition if they lose, ensuring accountability.

questions.solution: Firstly, political parties contest elections by selecting candidates to compete for political power. Secondly, the party that secures a majority forms and runs the government, implementing its proposed policies and programs. Thirdly, the losing parties play the crucial role of the opposition, constantly questioning the government's decisions, raising public awareness on key issues, and ensuring accountability in a democracy.

key_points: Reducing complicated paperwork and collateral requirements.
Expanding bank and cooperative branches in rural areas.
Providing loans at lower and affordable interest rates.

questions.solution: Formal sector loans can be made beneficial for the poor by heavily expanding the network of banks and cooperative societies in remote rural areas. sub_questions.text_english: There were variety of cultural processes through which Indian Nationalism captured people's imagination. Explain the statement with examples.

key_points: Creation of the visual image of Bharat Mata.
Revival of Indian folklore and traditional songs.
Designing of national icons and symbols like the tricolour flag.
Reinterpretation of history to glorify ancient achievements.

sub_questions.solution: Indian nationalism captured people's imagination through a rich variety of cultural processes that unified a diverse population against colonial rule. Firstly, the nation was visually personified as 'Bharat Mata'. Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay created this image and wrote the hymn 'Vande Mataram', instilling a deep sense of devotion. Later, Abanindranath Tagore painted her as an ascetic figure, calm and divine. Secondly, leaders like Rabindranath Tagore and Natesa Sastri spearheaded the revival of folklore, collecting ballads and myths to restore immense pride in traditional culture. Thirdly, icons and symbols like the Swadeshi tricolour flag and Gandhi's spinning wheel emerged as powerful, unifying emblems of defiance and self-reliance. Finally, Indians began reinterpreting history, rejecting the British narrative of backwardness, and instead glorifying India's ancient achievements in science, art, and philosophy, thereby inspiring a strong national identity.

sub_questions.text_english: How were the various social groups involved in the Civil Disobedience Movement? Explain with examples.

key_points: Rich peasant communities protested against high revenues.
Poor peasantry demanded remittance of unpaid rent.
Business classes opposed colonial policies that restricted business activities.
Women actively participated in salt marches and boycotting foreign goods.

sub_questions.solution: Various social groups participated in the Civil Disobedience Movement, each with their own specific aspirations. Rich peasant communities like the Patidars of Gujarat and Jats of Uttar Pradesh joined the movement out of deep frustration over the colonial government's refusal to reduce exorbitant revenue demands during the economic depression. The poor peasantry, struggling with falling incomes, joined radical movements hoping to have their unpaid rent to landlords completely remitted. The Indian business classes, led by prominent industrialists like G.D. Birla, actively supported the movement financially and boycotted foreign goods, aiming to dismantle colonial policies that severely restricted their trade growth. Lastly, women participated in extraordinarily large numbers, joining Gandhi's salt marches, manufacturing salt, and picketing liquor shops, seeing national service as a sacred duty.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the importance of agriculture in the Indian Economy.

key_points: Provides livelihood to more than half of the population.
Ensures food security for the massive population.
Supplies raw materials to major agro-based industries.
Contributes to exports and foreign exchange.

sub_questions.solution: Agriculture forms the backbone of the Indian economy due to its profound multi-dimensional importance. Primarily, it is the largest source of employment, providing direct livelihood to more than half of the country's population, particularly in rural areas. Secondly, it ensures crucial food security for a massive and growing population by producing staple crops like rice and wheat. Thirdly, agriculture supplies essential raw materials to several major agro-based industries, including the textile, sugar, and food processing sectors, thus driving industrial growth. Furthermore, agricultural products like tea, coffee, and spices form a significant portion of India's total exports, fetching valuable foreign exchange. Consequently, the overall economic growth and poverty eradication in India are inextricably linked to agricultural prosperity.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the Technological and Institutional reforms taken by the government in the interest of farmers.

key_points: Abolition of Zamindari and consolidation of land holdings.
Green Revolution introducing High Yielding Variety (HYV) seeds.
Establishment of Grameen banks and cooperative societies for credit.
Introduction of Kissan Credit Card (KCC) and crop insurance.
Announcement of Minimum Support Price (MSP).

sub_questions.solution: To modernize agriculture and improve farmers' conditions, the government introduced robust technological and institutional reforms. Institutionally, the post-independence government prioritized the abolition of the exploitative Zamindari system, implemented land ceilings, and promoted the consolidation of fragmented land holdings to make farming viable. Technologically, the Green Revolution brought High Yielding Variety (HYV) seeds, modern fertilizers, and advanced irrigation techniques, dramatically increasing crop yields. To protect farmers from financial distress, comprehensive crop insurance schemes against droughts and floods were launched. Furthermore, Grameen banks and cooperative societies were established to provide low-interest loans, breaking the monopoly of local moneylenders. Schemes like the Kissan Credit Card (KCC) and the timely announcement of Minimum Support Prices (MSP) have provided critical economic security to the farming community.

sub_questions.text_english: How do we assess democracy's outcomes? Explain.

key_points: Assessed through political outcomes: accountable and legitimate government.
Economic outcomes: economic growth, reduction of inequality.
Social outcomes: accommodation of social diversity, dignity and freedom of citizens.

sub_questions.solution: Democracy's outcomes are comprehensively assessed across political, economic, and social dimensions. Politically, democracy is evaluated by its ability to produce an accountable, responsive, and legitimate government where citizens enjoy the right to choose their rulers through free and fair elections. Economically, while democracies might marginally lag behind dictatorships in rapid economic growth, they are expected to effectively reduce severe economic disparities and work towards eradicating poverty. Socially, the success of a democracy is measured by how well it accommodates deep-rooted social diversities, preventing violent conflicts by sharing power. Ultimately, the most significant outcome of democracy is its unwavering commitment to promoting the profound dignity, freedom, and equal rights of all its citizens, particularly women and disadvantaged groups.

sub_questions.text_english: Democracy is an accountable, responsive and legitimate government. Explain the statement.

key_points: Accountable: Government answers to the people through elections and parliament.
Responsive: It formulates policies addressing public needs and opinions.
Legitimate: It is elected by the citizens themselves, making it their own government.

sub_questions.solution: Democracy is universally considered the best form of government because it embodies three core characteristics. It is 'accountable' because the elected representatives are answerable to the citizens. Regular, free, and fair elections allow people to change the government if it fails to perform. Furthermore, it guarantees transparency, giving citizens the right to examine decision-making processes. It is 'responsive' as it actively reacts to the needs, expectations, and demands of the public, formulating policies through thorough debate and discussion to serve the common good. Most importantly, it is a 'legitimate' government because it is elected by the people themselves. Even if it is sometimes slow or less efficient, it remains the people's own government, enjoying the overwhelming moral support of the entire nation.

sub_questions.text_english: Analyse the role of Liberalisation in the globalisation.

key_points: Liberalisation removes barriers/restrictions set by governments on foreign trade.
Allows free flow of goods, services, and capital across borders.
Encourages MNCs to invest and establish factories.
Promotes competition, improving product quality.

sub_questions.solution: Liberalisation has acted as a profound catalyst in driving the process of globalization. Essentially, liberalization refers to the removal of strict trade barriers and economic restrictions previously imposed by the government. By dismantling high import tariffs and rigid quotas, liberalization allows a massive and free flow of goods, services, and technology across international borders. This open environment heavily encourages Multinational Corporations (MNCs) to bring in substantial foreign direct investment (FDI), establishing production units and offices globally. Furthermore, it grants domestic producers the vital freedom to import advanced machinery and export their products worldwide. Consequently, liberalization fosters fierce but healthy global competition, significantly improving product quality and intricately integrating national markets into a single global economy.

sub_questions.text_english: Examine five factors to promote the process of globalisation.

key_points: Advancement in transportation technology.
Development of Information and Communication Technology (ICT).
Trade liberalization policies by governments.
Role of Multinational Corporations (MNCs).
Influence of international organizations like the WTO.

sub_questions.solution: The rapid process of globalization has been vigorously promoted by five interconnected factors. First, unprecedented advancements in transportation technology, notably containerization and air freight, have drastically reduced costs and enabled the swift delivery of goods globally. Second, explosive developments in Information and Communication Technology (ICT), such as the internet and satellites, have allowed instantaneous communication and seamless global data sharing. Third, the aggressive expansion of Multinational Corporations (MNCs) has physically integrated global production and supply chains by investing heavily across multiple nations. Fourth, the widespread adoption of liberalization policies by governments has systematically removed trade barriers, facilitating fluid cross-border economic activities. Fifth, powerful international organizations like the World Trade Organization (WTO) have actively pressured countries to liberalize, establishing standardized rules that mandate free and fair international trade.

निम्नलिखित स्रोत को पढ़िए और उसके नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर लिखिए :
पवित्र पेड़ों के झुरमुट-विविध और दुर्लभ जातियों की संपत्ति
प्रकृति की पूजा सदियों पुराना जनजातीय विश्वास है, जिसका आधार प्रकृति के हर रूप की रक्षा करना है। इन्हीं विश्वासों ने विभिन्न वनों को मूल एवं कौमार्य रूप में बचाकर रखा है, जिन्हें पवित्र पेड़ों के झुरमुट (देवी-देवताओं के वन) कहते हैं। वनों के इन भागों में या तो वनों के ऐसे बड़े भागों में स्थानीय लोग ही घुसते तथा न ही किसी और को छेड़छाड़ करने देते ।
कुछ समाज कुछ विशेष पेड़ों की पूजा करते हैं और आदिकाल से उनका संरक्षण करते आ रहे हैं। छोटानागपुर क्षेत्र में मुंडा और संथाल जनजातियाँ महुआ और कदंब के पेड़ों की पूजा करते हैं। ओडिशा और बिहार की जनजातियाँ शादी के दौरान इमली और आम के पेड़ की पूजा करती हैं। हममें से बहुत से व्यक्ति पीपल और वटवृक्ष को पवित्र मानते हैं।
भारतीय समाज में अनेकों संस्कृतियाँ हैं और प्रत्येक संस्कृति में प्रकृति और इसकी कृतियों को संरक्षित करने के अपने पारंपरिक तरीके हैं। आमतौर पर झरनों, पहाड़ी चोटियों, पेड़ों और पशुओं को पवित्र मानकर उनका संरक्षण किया जाता है। आप अनेक मंदिरों के आस-पास बंदर और लंगूर पाएँगे। उपासक उन्हें खिलाते-पिलाते हैं और मंदिर के भक्तों में गिनते हैं। राजस्थान में बिश्नोई गाँवों के आस-पास आप काले हिरण, चिंकारा, नीलगाय और मोरों के झुंड देख सकते हैं जो वहाँ के समुदाय का अभिन्न हिस्सा हैं और कोई उनको नुकसान नहीं पहुँचाता ।
questions.text_english:
Read the following source and answer the questions that follow:
Sacred Groves - A wealth of diverse and rare species
Nature worship is an age old tribal belief based on the premise that all creations of nature have to be protected. Such beliefs have preserved several virgin forests in pristine form called Sacred Groves (the forests of God and Goddesses). These patches of forest or parts of large forests have been left untouched by the local people and any interference with them is banned.
Certain societies revere a particular tree which they have preserved from time immemorial. The Mundas and the Santhal of Chota Nagpur region worship mahua (Bassia latifolia) and kadamba (Anthocaphalus cadamba) trees, and the tribals of Odisha and Bihar worship the tamarind (Tamarindus indica) and mango (mangifera indica) trees during weddings. To many of us, peepal and banyan trees are considered sacred.
Indian society comprises several cultures, each with its own set of traditional methods of conserving nature and its creations. Sacred qualities are often ascribed to springs, mountain peaks, plants and animals which are closely protected. You will find troops of macaques and langurs around many temples. They are fed daily and treated as a part of temple devotees. In and around Bishnoi villages in Rajasthan, herds of blackbuck, (chinkara), nilgai and peacocks can be seen as an integral part of the community and nobody harms them.

Panchayati Raj
We need to give more power to the panchayats to realise the dream of Mahatma Gandhi and the hopes of the makers of our Constitution, Panchayati Raj establishes true democracy. It restores power to the only place where power belongs in a democracy in the hands of the people. Giving power to Panchayats is also a way to reduce corruption and increase administrative efficiency. When people participate in the planning and implementation of developmental schemes, they would naturally exercise greater control over these schemes. This would eliminate the corrupt middlemen. Thus, Panchayati Raj will strengthen the foundations of our democracy.
